title: E.D.D.I — Operations Command Center
description: Comprehensive monitoring for EDDI v6 multi-agent orchestration platform. Covers conversations, tool execution, cache, rate limiting, cost, group discussions, triggers, quotas, audit, and infrastructure.

panels.title: EDDI up
panels.description: 0 when Prometheus cannot scrape EDDI (alert EddiDown). With several replicas, the lowest one.

panels.title: Tool Success % (1h)

targets.expr: (sum(increase(eddi_tool_execution_success_total{job=~"$job"}[1h])) or on() vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(increase(eddi_tool_execution_success_total{job=~"$job"}[1h])) or on() vector(0)) + (sum(increase(eddi_tool_execution_failure_total{job=~"$job"}[1h])) or on() vector(0)), 1e-9) and on() ((sum(increase(eddi_tool_execution_success_total{job=~"$job"}[1h])) or on() vector(0)) + (sum(increase(eddi_tool_execution_failure_total{job=~"$job"}[1h])) or on() vector(0))) > 0

panels.description: Successful / all tool executions in the last hour. A tool that has never failed has no failure series; it counts as zero failures.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(eddi_tool_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job"}[1h])) or on() vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(increase(eddi_tool_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job"}[1h])) or on() vector(0)) + (sum(increase(eddi_tool_cache_misses_total{job=~"$job"}[1h])) or on() vector(0)), 1e-9) and on() ((sum(increase(eddi_tool_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job"}[1h])) or on() vector(0)) + (sum(increase(eddi_tool_cache_misses_total{job=~"$job"}[1h])) or on() vector(0))) > 0

panels.title: Tool Cost (last 1h)
panels.description: Dollars spent on tool calls in the last hour. (Was rate() over 1h: dollars per SECOND, 3600x too low.)

panels.title: HTTP Latency (mean / peak)
panels.description: Mean and peak, not percentiles: http.server.requests publishes no histogram buckets. Buckets would multiply every series by ~70 for each of up to quarkus.micrometer.binder.http-server.max-uri-tags URI tags. The peak is Micrometer's decaying max, and long-lived streams (SSE) count as one long request.

panels.title: Processing Duration (mean / peak)
panels.description: eddi_conversation_processing_duration is a plain Micrometer Timer: it publishes _seconds_sum, _seconds_count and _seconds_max, but NOT _seconds_bucket. This panel used to run histogram_quantile over a *_bucket series that does not exist, so it was permanently empty. eddi.pipeline.task.duration is the only EDDI timer that calls publishPercentileHistogram(), and therefore the only one where a real percentile is available. 'peak' is the decaying max, not p100 of the window.

panels.title: Dead-lettered turns (in-memory coordinator)
panels.description: Turns that failed after they had started. The rate is cumulative across purges; 'retained' is what GET /administration/coordinator/dead-letters lists now (capped by eddi.coordinator.max-dead-letters). The NATS coordinator reports eddi_nats_dead_letter_count instead.

panels.title: Pending approvals
panels.description: Conversations paused for a human (approval or input), read from the conversation store every eddi.hitl.metrics.refresh-interval. Every replica reports the store-wide number, hence max. Saturates at 1000.

panels.title: Oldest pending approval
panels.description: How long the oldest pending approval has waited. Alert EddiApprovalWaitingLong fires past 24 h.

panels.title: Tool Spend Since Start
panels.description: eddi_tool_costs_accrued is a per-process running total that restarts at 0 with the process.

panels.title: Audit queue depth vs capacity
panels.description: Entries waiting to be written to the audit store. Entries are dropped (and counted on eddi_audit_entries_dropped_total) once the queue is full; alert EddiAuditQueueFilling fires at half.

panels.title: MongoDB Connection Pool
panels.description: mongodb_driver_pool_* from Micrometer's pool listener on EDDI's MongoDB client. Empty on the PostgreSQL datastore.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool (Agroal)
panels.description: Agroal pool meters (quarkus.datasource.metrics.enabled). Empty on the MongoDB datastore.

panels.title: NATS Messaging
panels.description: Only active under nats messaging profile. Shows 'No data' with in-memory messaging.

panels.title: Turn executor load
panels.description: Conversation work on the worker pool (managed) and the nested virtual-thread executor. Sustained 'waiting for a thread' means the pool is saturated (alert EddiExecutorSaturated).

panels.title: Quarkus worker pool
panels.description: Quarkus' own view of its worker pools: blocking REST requests and work dispatched through Vert.x. Turns submitted by the coordinator are on 'Turn executor load'.
